suggestions: I'm grateful for a staging deploy that caught the bug before it ever touched production.
I'm thankful for teh o ais being exactly as sweet as I remember after a brutal sprint.
I'm grateful for the masjid still having room for me even when I show up two minutes late.
I'm thankful for a Slack message that just said "nice work" and nothing else.
I'm grateful for catching the typo in the config file before the whole pipeline broke.
I'm thankful for my dad still asking if I've eaten, every single call.
I'm grateful for a quiet Saturday with nothing on the calendar, not even a meeting invite.
I'm thankful for the LRT aircon actually working on the hottest day this month.
I'm grateful for a manager who said take the day off and actually meant it.
I'm thankful for the few minutes before Fajr when the whole flat is silent and it feels like the day hasn't started yet.
I'm grateful for a bug report that turned out to be user error, not mine for once.
I'm thankful for roti canai still being cheap enough to grab on the way to work.
I'm grateful for a stable internet connection during a client demo that could've gone very wrong.
I'm thankful for my sister sending random memes in the family group chat, keeps things normal.
I'm grateful for a job that still feels secure when half of LinkedIn is posting open to work.
